description: Header file defining the Bbr2Sender class, a congestion control algorithm implementation for QUIC, including method declarations, class members, and related debug state structures.

classes.name: Bbr2Sender
classes.description: Implements the BBRv2 congestion control algorithm for QUIC, managing congestion window, pacing rate, and related states.

classes.name: DebugState
classes.description: Struct for exporting internal debug state of Bbr2Sender.

methods.name: InSlowStart
methods.description: Checks if the sender is in the startup mode.

methods.name: InRecovery
methods.description: Indicates if the sender is in recovery (not yet implemented).

methods.name: SetFromConfig
methods.description: Configures the sender from a QuicConfig object.

methods.name: ApplyConnectionOptions
methods.description: Applies connection options to the sender.

methods.name: AdjustNetworkParameters
methods.description: Adjusts network parameters based on current conditions.

methods.name: SetInitialCongestionWindowInPackets
methods.description: Sets the initial congestion window size.

methods.name: OnCongestionEvent
methods.description: Handles congestion events, updating internal state.

methods.name: OnPacketSent
methods.description: Handles packet sent events.

methods.name: OnPacketNeutered
methods.description: Handles packet neutering events.

methods.name: CanSend
methods.description: Determines if data can be sent based on current congestion window.

methods.name: PacingRate
methods.description: Returns the current pacing rate.

methods.name: BandwidthEstimate
methods.description: Returns the current bandwidth estimate.

methods.name: HasGoodBandwidthEstimateForResumption
methods.description: Indicates if bandwidth estimate is reliable for resumption.

methods.name: GetCongestionWindow
methods.description: Returns the current congestion window size.

methods.name: GetSlowStartThreshold
methods.description: Returns the slow start threshold (not used, returns 0).

methods.name: GetCongestionControlType
methods.description: Returns the congestion control type (kBBRv2).

methods.name: GetDebugState
methods.description: Returns a string representing the current debug state.

methods.name: OnApplicationLimited
methods.description: Handles application-limited state.

methods.name: PopulateConnectionStats
methods.description: Populates connection statistics.

methods.name: SupportsECT0
methods.description: Indicates support for ECT0 (false).

methods.name: SupportsECT1
methods.description: Indicates support for ECT1 (false).

methods.name: ExportDebugState
methods.description: Exports the debug state.
